profile.wikitext_hi:
{{प्रारूप लेख}}

{{ज्ञानसन्दूक वैज्ञानिक
| नाम = Vishwa Mohan Katoch
| संस्थान = Indian Council of Medical Research
}}

'''Vishwa Mohan Katoch''' एक  वैज्ञानिक हैं<ref name="src-f2b01627f6">{{cite web|url=https://www.tribuneindia.com/2011/20110324/cth1.htm|title=The Tribune, Chandigarh, India - Chandigarh Stories|website=tribuneindia.com}}</ref>।
Director-General of the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)<ref name="src-f2b01627f6" />।
Fellow of the Indian Academy of Sciences (FNA), the National Academy of Medical Sciences (FAMS), and the National Academy of Sciences, India (FNASc)<ref name="src-5d725c7ad5">{{cite web|url=https://fellows.ias.ac.in/profile/v/FL2007013|title=Indian Academy of Sciences|website=fellows.ias.ac.in}}</ref>।

== प्रारंभिक जीवन एवं शिक्षा ==
Holds an M.D. in Microbiology<ref name="src-0910c3ba8f">{{cite web|url=https://jaipur.manipal.edu/bom-chair.php|title=Board of Management {{!}}Chair -vManipal University Jaipur|website=jaipur.manipal.edu}}</ref>। Holds an M.D. in Microbiology<ref name="src-a71ae057e5">{{cite web|url=https://www.lepra.org.uk/centenary/people/details/dr-vishwa-mohan-katoch|title=Dr. Vishwa Mohan Katoch|website=lepra.org.uk}}</ref>। Holds an M.D. from the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)<ref name="src-5d725c7ad5" />।

== करियर ==
Director of the JALMA institute from December 2001 to November 2008<ref name="src-3be12bf1b2">{{cite web|url=https://ijl.org.in/editorial-team-profile|title=Editorial Team Profile {{!}} Indian Journal of Leprosy - a quarterly scientific|website=ijl.org.in|archive-url=http://web.archive.org/web/20231025055623/https://www.ijl.org.in/editorial-team-profile|archive-date=25 October 2023}}</ref>। Director-General of the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)<ref name="src-45b39666e6">{{cite web|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mangaluru/Puttur-likely-to-figure-in-pesticide-study/articleshow/9455695.cms|title=Puttur likely to figure in pesticide study - Times of India|website=timesofindia.indiatimes.com}}</ref>। Former Director-General of the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)<ref name="src-a25b66756e">{{cite web|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/india-facing-double-burden-of-nutritional-problems-avers-former-dg-icmr/articleshow/66369173.cms|title=India facing double burden of nutritional problems... - Times of India|website=timesofindia.indiatimes.com}}</ref>। Director-General of the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)<ref name="src-bf6b4a8b55">{{cite web|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/dr-vishwa-mohan-katoch-secretary-department-of-health-research-and-director-general-indian-council-of-medical-research-icmr-says-the-centre-has-decided-to-establish-a-large-network-of-virology-laboratories-in-the-country-at-a-cost-of-about-rs-800-to-1000-crore/articleshow/6819763.cms|title=Dr Vishwa Mohan Katoch, Secretary, Department of Health|website=timesofindia.indiatimes.com}}</ref>।

== चयनित शोध पत्र ==
* Authored a paper on early detection of multidrug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis using in-house FRET probes with real-time PCR<ref name="src-1976ae5d15">{{cite web|url=https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27295919|title=Early detection of multidrug resistant (MDR) Mycobacterium tuberculosis in a single tube with in-house designed fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) probes using real-time PCR.|website=PubMed|date=2016}}</ref>।
* Authored a paper on establishing a Biosafety Level-3 (BSL-3) laboratory in the Indian setting<ref name="src-f00f5c6031">{{cite web|url=https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/4216491|title=Establishment of Biosafety Level-3 (BSL-3) laboratory: important criteria to consider while designing, constructing, commissioning & operating the facility in Indian setting|website=PubMed Central|date=2014}}</ref>।

== पुरस्कार एवं सम्मान ==
Fellow of the National Academy of Sciences, India (FNASc), the National Academy of Medical Sciences (FAMS), and the Indian Academy of Sciences (FASc)<ref name="src-f5ca0b7bf3">{{cite web|url=https://www.infectiousdiseasescongress.com/files/images/advisory-board/biography-2020/vishwa-mohan-katoch-biography-dr.pdf|title=Biography - infectiousdiseasescongress.com|website=infectiousdiseasescongress.com}}</ref>।
